_about: Design tokens for the app forge builds. forge-design fills them in as roles (what each colour does); forge-brand later swaps the values for your own palette. Names stay, values change. Sizes are in px. Check every change with: python3 ../forge-design/contrast.py forge-work/design/tokens.json
_pairs: Every text and background combination the app uses. Third item: large (text from 24px, or 18.66px bold) needs 3:1; ui (input borders, icons, focus rings) needs 3:1; left out means normal text, which needs 4.5:1. Every text colour (text, fg or on in its name) must be in a pair; disabled ones are left out. Dark theme: add a dark group inside color and pairs such as ["dark-text", "dark-bg"].
_notes: The accent is a neutral grey placeholder until forge-brand picks the real one. Clone mode: list here every value you estimated instead of reading it off a screenshot's pixels or an eyedropper, such as: estimated: surface, border, radius.
_size: Fixed sizes that are not spacing, in px: border and focus ring widths, icons, control heights, the 44px target for main actions on mobile, a dialog's width. Add what the components need, by role.

font.sans: Inter Variable, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
